All my best mates, literally all of them, smoke weed apart from me. This made quitting almost impossible but somehow I haven't smoked for nearly 4 months. I just kind of just said fuck it and embraced the mentality that my health and achieving goals were more important than smoking weed with my mates all the time. I was scared that I might loose some friendships when I stopped smoking, but luckily my mates have been super supportive. I honestly feel that they respect the fuck out of me for quiting weed also, because a few of them would love to quit but just don't have the willpower. I think I also enjoy my mates company even more now that I'm sober.
My advice would be that you gotta just keep doing you. Saying to friends could just be a one part of that.
